```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, error = FALSE)
project_dir <- Sys.getenv("ADAPT_PROJECT_DIR", ".")
wf_note <- function(...) {
    line <- paste(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), paste(..., collapse = " "))
    log <- getOption("model255.progress_log")
    if (!is.null(log)) 
        cat(line, "\n", file = log, append = TRUE)
    flush.console()
}
wf_formula <- function(f) stats::as.formula(paste(deparse(f), collapse = " "), env = baseenv())
wf_compact <- function(f) {
    if (inherits(f, "merMod")) {
        attr(f@frame, "terms") <- local({
            t <- attr(f@frame, "terms")
            if (!is.null(t)) 
                environment(t) <- baseenv()
            t
        })
        if (inherits(f@call$formula, "formula")) 
            environment(f@call$formula) <- baseenv()
    }
    else if (inherits(f, "lm")) {
        if (!is.null(f$terms)) 
            environment(f$terms) <- baseenv()
        if (!is.null(f$model)) {
            t <- attr(f$model, "terms")
            if (!is.null(t)) 
                environment(t) <- baseenv()
            attr(f$model, "terms") <- t
        }
        if (inherits(f$call$formula, "formula")) 
            environment(f$call$formula) <- baseenv()
    }
    f
}
wf_save <- function(object, file) {
    if (inherits(object, c("lm", "merMod"))) 
        object <- wf_compact(object)
    dir.create(dirname(file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    tmp <- paste0(file, ".pending")
    base::saveRDS(object, tmp, compress = FALSE)
    if (!file.rename(tmp, file)) 
        stop("Could not finish checkpoint: ", file)
}
wf_fingerprint <- function(form, data) {
    cols <- all.vars(form)
    dd <- as.data.frame(data[, cols, drop = FALSE])
    dd[] <- lapply(dd, function(x) if (is.factor(x)) 
        as.character(x)
    else if (is.numeric(x)) 
        as.double(x)
    else x)
    digest::digest(list(formula = paste(deparse(form), collapse = " "), data = dd), algo = "sha256")
}
wf_ok <- function(f) {
    if (!inherits(f, "merMod")) 
        return(FALSE)
    msg <- f@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
    (is.null(f@optinfo$conv$opt) || all(f@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)) && !length(msg[!grepl("boundary.*singular", msg)])
}
wf_glmer <- function(form, data, legacy = NULL, optimizer = "nloptwrap", maxeval = 20000, maxfun = 2e+05, ...) {
    form <- wf_formula(form)
    signature <- list(fingerprint = wf_fingerprint(form, data), package = as.character(packageVersion("lme4")), 
        optimizer = optimizer, maxeval = maxeval, maxfun = maxfun)
    key <- digest::digest(signature, algo = "sha256")
    file <- file.path(wf_cache_dir, paste0(key, ".rds"))
    if (file.exists(file)) {
        old <- readRDS(file)
        if (identical(old$signature, signature)) {
            wf_note("CACHE", key)
            return(old$fit)
        }
    }
    if (!is.null(legacy) && file.exists(legacy) && file.info(legacy)$size < 64 * 1024^2) {
        old <- tryCatch(readRDS(legacy), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.list(old) && !is.null(old$signature$data) && inherits(old$fit, "merMod") && identical(old$signature$version, 
            signature$package)) {
            same <- identical(wf_fingerprint(form, data), wf_fingerprint(wf_formula(as.formula(paste(old$signature$formula, 
                collapse = " "))), old$signature$data))
            controls <- identical(old$signature$maxeval, maxeval) && identical(old$signature$maxfun, maxfun)
            if (same && controls && optimizer == "nloptwrap") {
                f <- wf_compact(old$fit)
                wf_save(list(signature = signature, fit = f), file)
                wf_note("REUSED", basename(legacy))
                return(f)
            }
        }
    }
    if (!wf_allow_fit) 
        stop("No valid checkpoint; enable fit_models for: ", paste(deparse(form), collapse = " "))
    wf_note("FIT", key, paste(deparse(form), collapse = " "))
    started <- Sys.time()
    f <- tryCatch(lme4::glmer(form, data = data, family = binomial, nAGQ = 1, control = lme4::glmerControl(optimizer = optimizer, 
        optCtrl = if (optimizer == "bobyqa") 
            list(maxfun = maxfun)
        else list(maxeval = maxeval))), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(f, "merMod") && !wf_ok(f) && optimizer != "bobyqa") {
        wf_note("RETRY bobyqa", key)
        retry <- tryCatch(lme4::glmer(form, data = data, family = binomial, start = list(theta = lme4::getME(f, 
            "theta"), fixef = lme4::fixef(f)), control = lme4::glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = maxfun))), 
            error = function(e) e)
        if (inherits(retry, "merMod")) 
            f <- retry
    }
    if (inherits(f, "merMod")) {
        f <- wf_compact(f)
        wf_save(list(signature = signature, fit = f), file)
    }
    wf_note("FINISHED", key, "seconds", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started, units = "secs")), 1))
    f
}
wf_lm <- function(formula, data, ...) {
    form <- wf_formula(formula)
    signature <- list(fingerprint = wf_fingerprint(form, data), R = as.character(getRversion()), type = "lm")
    file <- file.path(wf_cache_dir, paste0(digest::digest(signature, algo = "sha256"), ".rds"))
    if (file.exists(file)) {
        x <- readRDS(file)
        if (identical(x$signature, signature)) {
            wf_note("CACHE lm", basename(file))
            return(x$fit)
        }
    }
    if (!wf_allow_fit) 
        stop("Missing linear-model checkpoint")
    wf_note("FIT lm", paste(deparse(form), collapse = " "))
    f <- wf_compact(stats::lm(form, data = data, ...))
    wf_save(list(signature = signature, fit = f), file)
    f
}
wf_allow_fit <- isTRUE(params$fit_models)
```

```{r paths}
wf_note("SECTION paths")
project_dir <- Sys.getenv("ADAPT_PROJECT_DIR", ".")
target_dir <- Sys.getenv("EXP25_DATA_DIR", file.path(project_dir, "data", "exp_2.5"))
spread_dir <- file.path(target_dir, "spread_data_4")
fallback_spread_dir <- file.path(target_dir, "spread_data_2")
output_dir <- file.path(target_dir, "analysis", "model2.5.5_work_flow")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
study_figure_path <- function(path, project_dir, source_dir, study, section = NULL) {
    path <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    source_dir <- normalizePath(source_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    prefix <- paste0(sub("/+$", "", source_dir), "/")
    relative <- if (startsWith(path, prefix)) 
        substring(path, nchar(prefix) + 1L)
    else basename(path)
    destination <- file.path(project_dir, "Adapt", "figures_completed", study)
    if (!is.null(section)) 
        destination <- file.path(destination, section)
    destination <- file.path(destination, relative)
    dir.create(dirname(destination), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    normalizePath(destination, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}
dimension_figure_study <- function(filename) {
    name <- basename(filename)
    if (grepl("_2([_.]|$)", name) && !grepl("_2_5([_.]|$)", name)) 
        "2"
    else "2.5"
}
study_condition_colors <- c(`1` = "#000000", `2` = "#3155D9", `3` = "#D49A16", `4` = "#DC2680")
study_condition_shapes <- c(`1` = 16, `2` = 17, `3` = 15, `4` = 18)
study_word_colors <- c(eye = "#FF3D00", ear = "#00C9B7", hat = "#A3CE00", banana = "#7044FF")
study_term_condition <- function(term) {
    term <- as.character(term)
    ans <- rep("Shared", length(term))
    ans[term == "(Intercept)"] <- "1"
    hit <- grepl("condition[234]", term)
    ans[hit] <- sub(".*condition([234]).*", "\\1", term[hit])
    factor(ans, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "Shared"))
}
figure_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "Adapt", "figures_completed", "2.5.5")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(file.path(figure_dir, "extras", "notebook"), "/"), fig.keep = if (isTRUE(params$render_extras)) "all" else "none")

        "lexical"] %in% as.character(1:5)), all(task_map$map_occasion[task_map$task_kind == "ax"] %in% c("pre", 
        "post")))

legacy_model_dir <- file.path(target_dir, "analysis", "models")
```

```{r raw-import}
wf_note("SECTION raw-import")
export_pattern <- "^data_exp_[0-9]+-v[0-9]+_.*[.]csv$"
csv_files <- list.files(spread_dir, pattern = export_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(csv_files) > 0)
export_task <- function(paths) {
    n <- basename(paths)
    ifelse(grepl("_task-", n), sub("^.*_(task-[a-z0-9]+).*", "\\1", n), NA_character_)
}
allowed_fallback_tasks <- c("task-34gz", "task-f7vf", "task-gjva")
missing_tasks <- setdiff(task_map$task, export_task(csv_files))
unexpected_missing <- setdiff(missing_tasks, allowed_fallback_tasks)
if (length(unexpected_missing)) stop("Missing new-export tasks (no fallback authorized): ", paste(unexpected_missing, 
    collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
fallback_files <- character()
for (task_id in intersect(missing_tasks, allowed_fallback_tasks)) {
    candidates <- list.files(fallback_spread_dir, pattern = export_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
    candidates <- candidates[which(export_task(candidates) == task_id)]
    if (!length(candidates)) 
        stop("Missing fallback export for ", task_id, call. = FALSE)
    fallback_files <- c(fallback_files, candidates)
}
csv_files <- c(csv_files, fallback_files)
for (file in csv_files) {
    header <- names(read_csv(file, n_max = 0, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE))
    required <- c("Participant Private ID", "Experiment Version", "Tree Node Key")
    if (!all(required %in% header)) 
        stop("Invalid export header: ", file, call. = FALSE)
}
file_hashes <- unname(tools::md5sum(csv_files))
stopifnot(!anyNA(file_hashes))
keep <- !duplicated(file_hashes)
csv_files <- csv_files[keep]
file_hashes <- file_hashes[keep]
import_selection <- tibble(path = csv_files, source_file = basename(csv_files), task = export_task(csv_files), 
    md5 = file_hashes, collection = if_else(csv_files %in% fallback_files, "spread_data_2 fallback", "spread_data_4"))
write_csv(import_selection, file.path(output_dir, "import_file_selection.csv"))
if (any(import_selection$collection == "spread_data_2 fallback")) {
    message("Temporary older List 5 training exports: ", paste(import_selection$task[import_selection$collection == 
        "spread_data_2 fallback"], collapse = ", "))
}
all_data <- bind_rows(lapply(csv_files, function(file) {
    read_csv(file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(source_file = basename(file))
})) %>% filter(!is.na(`Participant Private ID`), !is.na(`Experiment Version`))
all_data <- all_data %>% left_join(task_map, by = c(`Tree Node Key` = "task"))
response_nodes <- all_data %>% filter(tolower(language) %in% c("hindi", "korean", "mandarin"), (`Zone Type` %in% 
    c("response_button_image", "timelimit_screen") & display %in% c("practice", "testing")) | (`Zone Type` %in% 
    c("response_keyboard", "timelimit_screen") & display == "trial"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(response_nodes$task_kind))
write_csv(all_data %>% count(source_file, `Task Name`, `Tree Node Key`, name = "rows"), file.path(output_dir, "import_file_inventory.csv"))
write_csv(all_data %>% distinct(`Participant Private ID`, `Experiment Version`, `Participant Status`) %>% count(`Experiment Version`, 
    `Participant Status`, name = "participants"), file.path(output_dir, "import_version_counts.csv"))
```

```{r task-import}
wf_note("SECTION task-import")
lexical_raw <- all_data %>% filter(task_kind == "lexical", `Zone Type` %in% c("response_button_image", "timelimit_screen"), 
    ((display == "practice" & `Screen Name` == "Screen 5") | (display == "testing" & `Screen Name` == "Screen 4"))) %>% 
    mutate(participant = `Participant Private ID`, session = paste(`Experiment Version`, `Schedule ID`, sep = "_"), 
        task = `Tree Node Key`, trial = `Spreadsheet Row`, item = paste(language, list_number, word, sep = "_"), 
        response = if_else(`Zone Type` == "timelimit_screen", NA_character_, Response), answer = case_when(ANSWER == 
            "q1" ~ q1, ANSWER == "q2" ~ q2, ANSWER == "q3" ~ q3, ANSWER == "q4" ~ q4), rt_ms = as.numeric(`Reaction Time`), 
        trial_order = as.numeric(`Trial Number`), phase = if_else(display == "practice", "training", "testing"), 
        spreadsheet = `Manipulation: Spreadsheet`, language = tolower(language), event_time = as.numeric(`UTC Timestamp`), 
        learning_number = map_learning_number, lexical_stage = case_when(learning_number %in% c("1", "2", "3", 
            "4") ~ "learning_1_4", learning_number == "5" ~ "learning_5", TRUE ~ "unmapped"), route = source_file, 
        correct = if_else(is.na(response) | response == "", NA_integer_, as.integer(response == answer)))
stopifnot(nrow(lexical_raw) > 0, !anyNA(lexical_raw$answer), all(lexical_raw$lexical_stage != "unmapped"))
stopifnot(all(lexical_raw$experiment == "2.5"), all(lexical_raw$language == lexical_raw$map_language), all(lexical_raw$learning_number == 
    lexical_raw$list_number))
assignment <- lexical_raw %>% filter(lexical_stage == "learning_1_4") %>% distinct(participant, language, initial_condition = learning_number)
stopifnot(all((assignment %>% count(participant, language))$n == 1))
lexical_raw <- lexical_raw %>% left_join(assignment, by = c("participant", "language"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(lexical_raw$initial_condition))
duplicate_trials <- lexical_raw %>% count(participant, session, task, trial) %>% filter(n > 1)
stopifnot(nrow(duplicate_trials) == 0)
data <- lexical_raw %>% group_by(participant, session, task, phase) %>% arrange(event_time, trial_order, .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(phase_order = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
completion_checks <- data %>% count(participant, initial_condition, language, lexical_stage, learning_number, phase, 
    name = "trials")
write_csv(completion_checks, file.path(output_dir, "completion_checks.csv"))
expected_modules <- crossing(language = c("hindi", "korean", "mandarin"), learning_number = as.character(1:5), 
    phase = c("training", "testing"))
module_coverage <- data %>% count(language, learning_number, phase, name = "response_trials") %>% right_join(expected_modules, 
    by = c("language", "learning_number", "phase")) %>% mutate(response_trials = coalesce(response_trials, 0L), 
    downloaded = response_trials > 0)
write_csv(module_coverage, file.path(output_dir, "spread_data_module_coverage.csv"))
if (any(!module_coverage$downloaded)) {
    warning("spread_data is incomplete: preview plots exclude one or more expected lexical modules. See spread_data_module_coverage.csv before interpreting cell sizes.")
}
write_csv(data, file.path(output_dir, "lexical_response_data.csv"))
```

```{r participant-review}
wf_note("SECTION participant-review")
rt_participant_quality <- data %>% filter(!is.na(response), response != "", is.finite(rt_ms), rt_ms > 0) %>% mutate(log_rt = log(rt_ms)) %>% 
    group_by(participant, language, initial_condition, task, lexical_stage, phase) %>% summarise(rt_trials = n(), 
    median_rt_ms = median(rt_ms), median_log_rt = median(log_rt), .groups = "drop") %>% group_by(language, initial_condition, 
    task, lexical_stage, phase) %>% mutate(group_n = n(), group_median_log_rt = median(median_log_rt), group_mad_log_rt = mad(median_log_rt, 
    constant = 1.4826), phase_rt_outlier = group_mad_log_rt > 0 & abs(median_log_rt - group_median_log_rt) > 3 * 
    group_mad_log_rt) %>% ungroup()
participant_rt_exclusions <- rt_participant_quality %>% group_by(participant) %>% summarise(rt_phases_screened = n(), 
    rt_outlier_phases = sum(phase_rt_outlier), rt_quality_exclude = any(phase_rt_outlier), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(rt_participant_quality, file.path(output_dir, "participant_rt_quality_by_phase.csv"))
write_csv(participant_rt_exclusions, file.path(output_dir, "participant_rt_quality_exclusions.csv"))
review_file <- file.path(target_dir, "participant_review.csv")
review_input <- if (file.exists(review_file)) read_csv(review_file, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(participant = col_character(), 
    exclude = col_logical(), reason = col_character())) else tibble(participant = character(), exclude = logical(), 
    reason = character())
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(review_input$participant))
participant_review <- data %>% distinct(participant) %>% left_join(review_input, by = "participant") %>% mutate(review_pending = is.na(exclude), 
    manual_exclude = coalesce(exclude, FALSE), manual_reason = reason) %>% left_join(participant_rt_exclusions, 
    by = "participant") %>% mutate(rt_phases_screened = coalesce(rt_phases_screened, 0L), rt_outlier_phases = coalesce(rt_outlier_phases, 
    0L), rt_quality_exclude = coalesce(rt_quality_exclude, FALSE), exclude = manual_exclude | rt_quality_exclude, 
    reason = case_when(rt_quality_exclude ~ paste0("RT exclusion: median log RT beyond 3 scaled MADs in at least one lexical phase", 
        if_else(manual_exclude, paste0("; manual exclusion: ", coalesce(manual_reason, "reason unspecified")), 
            "")), manual_exclude ~ coalesce(manual_reason, "Manual exclusion"), rt_phases_screened < 4L ~ "Incomplete RT screen; manual review required", 
        review_pending ~ "Retained by RT rule; other eligibility review pending", TRUE ~ coalesce(manual_reason, 
            "Retained")))
write_csv(participant_review, file.path(output_dir, "participant_review_to_complete.csv"))
write_csv(participant_review, file.path(output_dir, "participant_review_applied.csv"))
participant_removal <- data %>% distinct(participant, initial_condition, language) %>% left_join(participant_review, 
    by = "participant") %>% count(initial_condition, language, exclude, reason, name = "participants")
write_csv(participant_removal, file.path(output_dir, "participant_removal.csv"))
participant_retention_counts <- data %>% distinct(participant, initial_condition, language) %>% left_join(participant_review, 
    by = "participant") %>% group_by(language, initial_condition) %>% summarise(before = n(), rt_excluded = sum(rt_quality_exclude), 
    excluded = sum(exclude), retained = sum(!exclude), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(participant_retention_counts, file.path(output_dir, "participant_retention_counts.csv"))
```

```{r behavioral-cleanup}
wf_note("SECTION behavioral-cleanup")
data_cleaned <- data %>% filter(participant %in% participant_review$participant[!participant_review$exclude]) %>% 
    mutate(missing_response = is.na(response) | response == "", log_rt = if_else(is.finite(rt_ms) & rt_ms > 0, 
        log(pmax(rt_ms, 0.001)), NA_real_))
accuracy_data <- data_cleaned %>% filter(!is.na(correct))
rt_screening <- accuracy_data %>% filter(correct == 1, is.finite(rt_ms), rt_ms > 0) %>% group_by(participant, language, 
    task, lexical_stage, phase) %>% mutate(rt_group_n = n(), median_log_rt = median(log_rt), mad_rt = mad(log_rt, 
    constant = 1), rt_outlier = rt_group_n >= 5 & mad_rt > 0 & abs(log_rt - median_log_rt) > 3 * mad_rt) %>% ungroup()
rt_data <- rt_screening %>% filter(!rt_outlier)
stopifnot(!any(rt_data$rt_outlier))
trial_retention <- data_cleaned %>% group_by(initial_condition, language, lexical_stage, phase) %>% summarise(total = n(), 
    omissions = sum(missing_response), accuracy_trials = sum(!is.na(correct)), .groups = "drop") %>% left_join(rt_screening %>% 
    group_by(initial_condition, language, lexical_stage, phase) %>% summarise(rt_candidates = n(), rt_outliers_removed = sum(rt_outlier), 
    rt_retained = sum(!rt_outlier), .groups = "drop"), by = c("initial_condition", "language", "lexical_stage", 
    "phase"))
write_csv(trial_retention, file.path(output_dir, "trial_retention.csv"))
write_csv(rt_screening %>% select(participant, language, initial_condition, session, task, trial, item, lexical_stage,
```

```{r decode-cue-responses}
wf_note("SECTION decode-cue-responses")
condition_labels <- c(`1` = "1: Least dense", `2` = "2: Cue 1 dense", `3` = "3: Cue 2 dense", `4` = "4: Both dense")
cue_map <- tibble::tribble(~language, ~cue_type, ~cue, ~contrast_name, "hindi", "aspirated", "Cue1", "Aspiration", 
    "hindi", "voiced", "Cue2", "Voicing", "korean", "b_bb", "Cue1", "Lax–tense stop", "korean", "n_ng", "Cue2", 
    "Nasal coda", "mandarin", "tonal", "Cue1", "Tone", "mandarin", "fricative", "Cue2", "Consonant place")
contrast_labels <- list(hindi = c(Cue1 = "Aspiration (aspirated–unaspirated)", Cue2 = "Voicing (voiced–voiceless)"), 
    korean = c(Cue1 = "Stop (b–bb)", Cue2 = "Coda (n–ng)"), mandarin = c(Cue1 = "Tone (1–3)", Cue2 = "Consonant (zh–j)"))
contrast_short <- list(hindi = c("Aspiration", "Voicing"), korean = c("b–bb", "n–ng"), mandarin = c("Tone", 
    "zh–j"))
cue_display <- function(cue, language) mapply(function(c, l) unname(contrast_labels[[l]][c]), as.character(cue), 
    as.character(language), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
condition_display <- function(condition, language) mapply(function(c, l) {
    labels <- c("1: Least dense", paste0("2: ", contrast_short[[l]][1], " dense"), paste0("3: ", contrast_short[[l]][2], 
        " dense"), "4: Both dense")
    labels[as.integer(as.character(c))]
}, condition, language, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

word_key <- data %>% distinct(participant, language, learning_number, word, answer)

    sub(".*_", "", word)), cue2 = case_when(language == "hindi" ~ if_else(grepl("^b", word), "voiced", "voiceless"),

        word), "retroflex", "alveolopalatal")))
stopifnot(all(grepl("^[bp]h?", word_key$word[word_key$language == "hindi"])), all(grepl("^b.*n(g)?$", word_key$word[word_key$language == 
    "korean"])), all(grepl("^(zh|j).*_[13]$", word_key$word[word_key$language == "mandarin"])))
cue_responses <- accuracy_data %>% select(participant, language, initial_condition, learning_number, lexical_stage, 
    phase, task, trial, word, answer, response, correct, q1, q2, q3, q4) %>% left_join(word_key %>% select(-answer) %>% 
    rename(target_cue1 = cue1, target_cue2 = cue2), by = c("participant", "language", "learning_number", "word")) %>% 
    left_join(word_key %>% rename(response = answer, selected_word = word, selected_cue1 = cue1, selected_cue2 = cue2), 
        by = c("participant", "language", "learning_number", "response")) %>% mutate(cue1_match = as.integer(target_cue1 == 
    selected_cue1), cue2_match = as.integer(target_cue2 == selected_cue2), response_class = case_when(correct == 
    1 ~ "Correct word", cue1_match == 1 & cue2_match == 1 ~ "Wrong word: both cues match", cue1_match == 1 ~ "Wrong word: Cue 1 matches", 
    cue2_match == 1 ~ "Wrong word: Cue 2 matches", TRUE ~ "Wrong word: neither matches"), condition = factor(initial_condition, 
    levels = as.character(1:4)), model_item = paste(language, word, sep = "_"), response_id = paste(participant, 
    task, trial, sep = "_"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(cue_responses$selected_word), !anyNA(cue_responses$target_cue1), !anyDuplicated(cue_responses$response_id), 
    all(cue_responses$correct == as.integer(cue_responses$word == cue_responses$selected_word)), all(cue_responses$cue1_match[cue_responses$correct == 
        1] == 1), all(cue_responses$cue2_match[cue_responses$correct == 1] == 1))
alternatives <- cue_responses %>% select(response_id, participant, language, learning_number, lexical_stage, phase, 
    initial_condition, word, answer, target_cue1, target_cue2, q1, q2, q3, q4) %>% pivot_longer(q1:q4, names_to = "position", 
    values_to = "picture") %>% left_join(word_key %>% rename(picture = answer, alternative_word = word, alternative_cue1 = cue1, 
    alternative_cue2 = cue2), by = c("participant", "language", "learning_number", "picture")) %>% mutate(option_cue1_match = target_cue1 == 
    alternative_cue1, option_cue2_match = target_cue2 == alternative_cue2)
stopifnot(!anyNA(alternatives$alternative_word), all((alternatives %>% count(response_id))$n == 4))
opportunity <- alternatives %>% group_by(response_id) %>% summarise(chance_cue1 = mean(option_cue1_match), chance_cue2 = mean(option_cue2_match), 
    options_both = sum(option_cue1_match & option_cue2_match), options_cue1_only = sum(option_cue1_match & !option_cue2_match), 
    options_cue2_only = sum(!option_cue1_match & option_cue2_match), options_neither = sum(!option_cue1_match & 
        !option_cue2_match), .groups = "drop")
cue_responses <- cue_responses %>% left_join(opportunity, by = "response_id")
cue_long <- cue_responses %>% pivot_longer(c(cue1_match, cue2_match), names_to = "cue", values_to = "cue_match") %>% 
    mutate(cue = factor(if_else(cue == "cue1_match", "Cue1", "Cue2"), levels = c("Cue1", "Cue2")), chance = if_else(cue == 
        "Cue1", chance_cue1, chance_cue2)) %>% left_join(cue_map, by = c("language", "cue"))
stopifnot(all(cue_long$chance == 0.5))
write_csv(word_key, file.path(output_dir, "participant_word_cue_key.csv"))
write_csv(cue_map, file.path(output_dir, "model_cue_mapping.csv"))
write_csv(cue_responses, file.path(output_dir, "cue_scored_responses.csv"))
write_csv(alternatives %>% distinct(language, learning_number, word, target_cue1, target_cue2, alternative_word,
```

```{r rq1-selected-fit}
wf_note("SECTION rq1-selected-fit")
library(emmeans)
model_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
rq1_select_random <- function(d, lang, model_dir) {
    d <- as.data.frame(d)
    d$condition <- factor(d$condition, levels = 1:4)
    d$participant <- factor(d$participant)
    d$model_item <- factor(d$model_item)
    stopifnot(!anyNA(d[c("correct", "condition", "participant", "model_item")]), all(d$correct %in% 0:1), all(tapply(d$condition, 
        d$participant, function(x) length(unique(x))) == 1))
    for (j in 2:4) d[[paste0("c", j)]] <- as.numeric(d$condition == j)
    coverage <- distinct(as_tibble(d), model_item, condition)
    write_csv(coverage, file.path(model_dir, paste0("RQ1_", lang, "_item_condition_coverage.csv")))
    cov_design <- function(slopes, correlated) {
        zz <- model.matrix(reformulate(slopes), d)
        pairs <- if (correlated) 
            which(upper.tri(matrix(0, ncol(zz), ncol(zz)), diag = TRUE), arr.ind = TRUE)
        else cbind(seq_len(ncol(zz)), seq_len(ncol(zz)))
        blocks <- lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(d)), d$model_item), function(ii) {
            z <- unique(zz[ii, , drop = FALSE])
            ab <- expand.grid(a = seq_len(nrow(z)), b = seq_len(nrow(z)))
            sapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
                a <- pairs[k, 1]
                b <- pairs[k, 2]
                z[ab$a, a] * z[ab$b, b] + if (a != b) 
                  z[ab$a, b] * z[ab$b, a]
                else 0
            })
        })
        mm <- do.call(rbind, blocks)
        c(rank = qr(mm)$rank, parameters = ncol(mm))
    }
    specs <- list(maximal_correlated = list(slopes = c("c2", "c3", "c4"), correlated = TRUE))
    for (n in 3:0) {
        sets <- if (n == 0) 
            list(character())
        else combn(c("c2", "c3", "c4"), n, simplify = FALSE)
        for (s in sets) specs[[if (length(s)) 
            paste0("independent_", paste(s, collapse = "_"))
        else "random_intercepts"]] <- list(slopes = s, correlated = FALSE)
    }
    fits <- list()
    rows <- list()
    for (nm in names(specs)) {
        sp <- specs[[nm]]
        rk <- cov_design(sp$slopes, sp$correlated)
        rhs <- if (sp$correlated) 
            "(1+c2+c3+c4|model_item)"
        else paste(c("(1|model_item)", paste0("(0+", sp$slopes, "|model_item)")[seq_along(sp$slopes)]), collapse = "+")
        ff <- as.formula(paste("correct~condition+(1|participant)+", rhs))
        f <- NULL
        ww <- character()
        cv <- FALSE
        sg <- NA
        if (rk[1] == rk[2]) {
            message(lang, ": ", nm)
            f <- withCallingHandlers(tryCatch(wf_glmer(ff, data = d, optimizer = "bobyqa"), error = function(e) e), 
                warning = function(w) {
                  ww <<- c(ww, conditionMessage(w))
                  invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
                })
            if (inherits(f, "merMod")) {
                msgs <- f@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
                cv <- (is.null(f@optinfo$conv$opt) || all(f@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)) && !length(msgs[!grepl("boundary.*singular", 
                  msgs)])
                sg <- lme4::isSingular(f)
                ww <- unique(c(ww, msgs))
                wf_save(f, file.path(model_dir, paste0("RQ1_", lang, "_candidate_", nm, ".rds")))
            }
            else ww <- conditionMessage(f)
        }
        else ww <- "Skipped: random covariance components not identifiable from item-condition coverage"
        ok <- inherits(f, "merMod")
        fits[[nm]] <- f
        rows[[nm]] <- tibble(language = lang, candidate = nm, formula = paste(deparse(ff), collapse = " "), covariance_rank = rk[1], 
            covariance_parameters = rk[2], converged = cv, singular = sg, eligible = ok && cv && !isTRUE(sg), AIC = if (ok) 
                AIC(f)
            else NA_real_, diagnostic = paste(ww, collapse = "; "))
        write_csv(bind_rows(rows), file.path(model_dir, paste0("RQ1_", lang, "_random_selection.csv")))
    }
    tab <- bind_rows(rows)
    if (!any(tab$eligible)) 
        stop("RQ1 ", lang, ": no converged nonsingular candidate. See selection log.")
    best <- tab$candidate[which.min(ifelse(tab$eligible, tab$AIC, Inf))]
    tab <- tab %>% mutate(selected = candidate == best, delta_AIC = if_else(eligible, AIC - min(AIC[eligible]), 
        NA_real_))
    write_csv(tab, file.path(model_dir, paste0("RQ1_", lang, "_random_selection.csv")))
    wf_save(fits[[best]], file.path(model_dir, paste0("RQ1_overall_", lang, ".rds")))
    list(model = fits[[best]], selection = tab)
}
model_specs <- list(RQ1_overall = correct ~ condition + (1 | participant) + (1 | model_item))
model_inputs <- list(RQ1_overall = initial)
models <- list()
diagnostic_rows <- list()
coefficient_rows <- list()
collinearity_rows <- list()
for (spec in names(model_specs)) for (lang in c("hindi", "korean", "mandarin")) {
    key <- paste(spec, lang, sep = "_")
    is_ax <- startsWith(spec, "RQ2")
    dd <- as.data.frame(filter(model_inputs[[spec]], language == lang))
    stopifnot(nrow(dd) > 0, length(unique(dd$condition)) == 4)
    mm <- model.matrix(lme4::nobars(model_specs[[spec]]), dd)
    stopifnot(qr(mm)$rank == ncol(mm))
    warnings_seen <- character()
    fit <- if (spec == "RQ1_overall") {
        selected_rq1 <- rq1_select_random(dd, lang, model_dir)
        selected_rq1$model
    }
    else withCallingHandlers({
        glmer(model_specs[[spec]], data = dd, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e+05)))
    }, warning = function(w) {
        warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    })
    conv <- fit@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
    numerical_messages <- conv[!grepl("boundary.*singular", conv)]
    converged <- (is.null(fit@optinfo$conv$opt) || all(fit@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)) && length(numerical_messages) == 
        0
    if (!converged) 
        stop("Nonconverged model: ", key, "; ", paste(conv, collapse = "; "))
    models[[key]] <- fit
    wf_save(fit, file.path(model_dir, paste0(key, ".rds")))
    diagnostic_rows[[key]] <- tibble(model = spec, language = lang, observations = nobs(fit), participants = n_distinct(dd$participant), 
        items = if (is_ax) 
            NA_integer_
        else n_distinct(dd$model_item), converged = converged, singular = isSingular(fit), AIC = AIC(fit), fixed_design_condition_number = kappa(mm), 
        warnings = paste(unique(c(warnings_seen, conv)), collapse = "; "))
    cc <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(fit)))
    coefficient_rows[[key]] <- tibble(model = spec, language = lang, term = rownames(cc), estimate = cc$Estimate, 
        SE = cc$`Std. Error`) %>% mutate(lower = estimate - qnorm(0.975) * SE, upper = estimate + qnorm(0.975) * 
        SE, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(estimate/SE)), stars = case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ 
        "*", TRUE ~ ""))
    capture.output(summary(fit), file = file.path(model_dir, paste0(key, "_summary.txt")))
    write_csv(as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit)), file.path(model_dir, paste0(key, "_random_effects.csv")))
}
model_diagnostics <- bind_rows(diagnostic_rows)
model_coefficients <- bind_rows(coefficient_rows)
write_csv(model_diagnostics, file.path(output_dir, "model_diagnostics.csv"))
write_csv(model_coefficients, file.path(output_dir, "model_coefficients.csv"))
predictor_correlations <- bind_rows(lapply(c("hindi", "korean", "mandarin"), function(lang) {
    dd <- transfer_predictors %>% filter(language == lang, complete_predictors) %>% select(overall_accuracy, cue1_accuracy, 
        cue2_accuracy, delta_Cue1, delta_Cue2)
    out <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor(dd)))
    names(out) <- c("predictor_1", "predictor_2", "correlation")
    mutate(out, language = lang)
}))
write_csv(predictor_correlations, file.path(output_dir, "predictor_correlations.csv"))
```

```{r theory-setup}
wf_note("SECTION theory-setup")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
theory_dir <- normalizePath(output_dir)
ax <- read_csv(file.path(theory_dir, "descriptive_ax_pre_post_change.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% left_join(read_csv(file.path(theory_dir, 
    "model_cue_mapping.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE), by = c("language", "cue_type"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(ax$cue), !anyDuplicated(ax[c("participant", "language", "cue")]))
baseline <- ax %>% select(participant, language, cue, pre) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cue, values_from = pre, 
    names_prefix = "pre_")
ax <- left_join(ax, baseline, by = c("participant", "language")) %>% mutate(condition = factor(initial_condition, 
    levels = 1:4))
labels <- list(hindi = c(Cue1 = "Aspiration", Cue2 = "Voicing"), korean = c(Cue1 = "Stop (b–bb)", Cue2 = "Coda (n–ng)"), 
    mandarin = c(Cue1 = "Tone (1–3)", Cue2 = "Consonant (zh–j)"))
coef_rows <- list()
selection_rows <- list()
comparison_rows <- list()
prediction_rows <- list()
residual_rows <- list()
data_rows <- list()
for (lang in c("hindi", "korean", "mandarin")) for (cu in c("Cue1", "Cue2")) {
    dd0 <- filter(ax, language == lang, cue == cu)
    dd <- dd0 %>% filter(is.finite(post), is.finite(pre_Cue1), is.finite(pre_Cue2), !is.na(condition)) %>% mutate(pre1_c = pre_Cue1 - 
        mean(pre_Cue1), pre2_c = pre_Cue2 - mean(pre_Cue2)) %>% as.data.frame()
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(dd$participant), n_distinct(dd$condition) == 4)
    key <- paste(lang, cu, sep = "_")
    title <- paste(tools::toTitleCase(lang), labels[[lang]][[cu]], sep = " — ")
    full <- wf_lm(post ~ condition * (pre1_c + pre2_c), dd, na.action = na.fail)
    stopifnot(full$rank == ncol(model.matrix(full)))
    wf_save(full, file.path(theory_dir, "models", paste0("RQ2_theory_start_", key, ".rds")))
    current <- full
    active <- c("condition:pre1_c", "condition:pre2_c")
    step <- 0
    repeat {
        if (!length(active)) 
            break
        step <- step + 1
        tests <- list()
        fits <- list()
        for (term in active) {
            reduced <- wf_lm(reformulate(c("condition", "pre1_c", "pre2_c", setdiff(active, term)), response = "post"), 
                dd, na.action = na.fail)
            stopifnot(nobs(reduced) == nobs(current), reduced$rank == ncol(model.matrix(reduced)))
            comparison <- anova(reduced, current)
            fits[[term]] <- reduced
            tests[[term]] <- tibble(language = lang, cue = cu, step = step, term = term, F = comparison$F[2], df = comparison$Df[2], 
                p = comparison$`Pr(>F)`[2], AIC_current = AIC(current), AIC_reduced = AIC(reduced))
        }
        tests <- bind_rows(tests)
        eligible <- filter(tests, p >= 0.05) %>% arrange(desc(p))
        remove <- if (nrow(eligible)) 
            eligible$term[1]
        else ""
        tests$removed <- tests$term == remove
        comparison_rows[[paste(key, step)]] <- tests
        if (!nzchar(remove)) 
            break
        current <- fits[[remove]]
        active <- setdiff(active, remove)
    }
    stopifnot(all(c("condition2", "condition3", "condition4", "pre1_c", "pre2_c") %in% names(coef(current))), all(is.finite(vcov(current))))
    wf_save(current, file.path(theory_dir, "models", paste0("RQ2_theory_selected_", key, ".rds")))
    capture.output(summary(current), file = file.path(theory_dir, "models", paste0("RQ2_theory_selected_", key, 
        "_summary.txt")))
    selection_rows[[key]] <- tibble(language = lang, cue = cu, outcome = title, participants = nobs(current), excluded_incomplete = nrow(dd0) - 
        nrow(dd), retained_interactions = if (length(active)) 
        paste(active, collapse = "; ")
    else "None", formula = paste(deparse(formula(current)), collapse = " "), R_squared = summary(current)$r.squared, 
        residual_sd = sigma(current), max_Cooks_distance = max(cooks.distance(current)))
    terms <- c(`(Intercept)` = "Intercept (least dense; mean pre-test AX)", condition2 = paste0(labels[[lang]][1], 
        " dense (baseline: least dense)"), condition3 = paste0(labels[[lang]][2], " dense (baseline: least dense)"), 
        condition4 = "Both dense (baseline: least dense)", pre1_c = paste(labels[[lang]][1], "pre-test AX"), pre2_c = paste(labels[[lang]][2], 
            "pre-test AX"))
    for (k in 2:4) for (j in 1:2) terms[paste0("condition", k, ":pre", j, "_c")] <- paste0(c(labels[[lang]][1], 
        labels[[lang]][2], "Both")[k - 1], " dense × ", labels[[lang]][j], " pre-test AX\n(baseline: least-dense slope)")
    cc <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(current)))
    ci <- confint(current)
    stopifnot(all(rownames(cc) %in% names(terms)))
    coef_rows[[key]] <- tibble(language = lang, cue = cu, outcome = title, term = rownames(cc), label = unname(terms[rownames(cc)]), 
        estimate = cc$Estimate, SE = cc$`Std. Error`, p = cc$`Pr(>|t|)`, lower = ci[, 1], upper = ci[, 2])
    residual_rows[[key]] <- tibble(language = lang, cue = cu, participant = dd$participant, fitted = fitted(current), 
        residual = residuals(current), standardized_residual = rstandard(current), Cooks_distance = cooks.distance(current))
    data_rows[[key]] <- dd
    for (co in as.character(1:4)) {
        pred <- if (cu == "Cue1") 
            "pre1_c"
        else "pre2_c"
        raw <- if (cu == "Cue1") 
            "pre_Cue1"
        else "pre_Cue2"
        range <- range(dd[dd$condition == co, pred])
        grid <- data.frame(condition = factor(rep(co, 80), levels = 1:4), pre1_c = 0, pre2_c = 0)
        grid[[pred]] <- seq(range[1], range[2], length.out = 80)
        pr <- predict(current, grid, interval = "confidence")
        prediction_rows[[paste(key, co)]] <- tibble(language = lang, cue = cu, outcome = title, condition = co, 
            pre = grid[[pred]] + mean(dd[[raw]]), estimate = pr[, "fit"], lower = pr[, "lwr"], upper = pr[, "upr"])
    }
}
theory_selection <- bind_rows(selection_rows)
theory_coef <- bind_rows(coef_rows)
theory_predictions <- bind_rows(prediction_rows)
theory_tests <- bind_rows(comparison_rows)
theory_residuals <- bind_rows(residual_rows)
stopifnot(nrow(theory_selection) == 6, nrow(theory_predictions) == 1920)
write_csv(theory_selection, file.path(theory_dir, "rq2_theory_selection.csv"))
write_csv(theory_coef, file.path(theory_dir, "rq2_theory_coefficients.csv"))
write_csv(theory_predictions, file.path(theory_dir, "rq2_theory_predictions.csv"))
write_csv(theory_tests, file.path(theory_dir, "rq2_theory_comparisons.csv"))
write_csv(theory_residuals, file.path(theory_dir, "rq2_theory_residuals.csv"))
write_csv(bind_rows(data_rows), file.path(theory_dir, "rq2_theory_model_data.csv"))
```

```{r rq3-posthoc-fit}
wf_note("SECTION rq3-posthoc-fit")
local({
    posthoc_dir <- normalizePath(output_dir)
    previous_dir <- getwd()
    on.exit(setwd(previous_dir), add = TRUE)
    setwd(posthoc_dir)
    for (posthoc_outcome in c("overall", "Cue1", "Cue2")) {
        library(lme4)
        library(dplyr)
        library(readr)
        library(tidyr)
        outcome <- posthoc_outcome
        stopifnot(outcome %in% c("overall", "Cue1", "Cue2"))
        d <- read_csv("rq3_model_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
        n_original <- nrow(d)
        a <- read_csv("rq2_model_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
        stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(a[c("participant", "language", "cue")]))
        pre <- a %>% select(participant, language, cue, pre) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cue, values_from = pre, 
            names_prefix = "pre_")
        d <- left_join(d, pre, by = c("participant", "language"))
        stopifnot(nrow(d) == n_original, all(is.finite(d$pre_Cue1)), all(is.finite(d$pre_Cue2)))
        check <- d %>% distinct(participant, language, delta_Cue1, delta_Cue2) %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("delta_"), 
            names_to = "cue", names_prefix = "delta_", values_to = "delta") %>% left_join(a %>% select(participant, 
            language, cue, change, pre, post), by = c("participant", "language", "cue"))
        stopifnot(all(abs(check$delta - check$change) < 1e-10), all(abs(check$post - check$pre - check$delta) < 
            1e-10))
        centers <- d %>% distinct(participant, language, pre_Cue1, pre_Cue2) %>% group_by(language) %>% summarise(pre1_center = mean(pre_Cue1), 
            pre2_center = mean(pre_Cue2), .groups = "drop")
        d <- left_join(d, centers, by = "language") %>% mutate(pre1_c = pre_Cue1 - pre1_center, pre2_c = pre_Cue2 - 
            pre2_center, condition = factor(condition, levels = 1:4), participant = factor(participant), model_item = factor(model_item))
        write_csv(d, paste0("rq3_posthoc_data_", outcome, ".csv"))
        independent <- function(v) paste(c("(1|participant)", "(1|model_item)", if (length(v)) paste0("(0+", v, 
            "|model_item)")), collapse = "+")
        main <- "condition+overall_accuracy_c+pre1_c+delta1_c+pre2_c+delta2_c"
        interactions <- c("condition:overall_accuracy_c", "pre1_c:delta1_c", "pre2_c:delta2_c")
        fullfixed <- paste(c(main, interactions), collapse = "+")
        rhs <- c(maximal_correlated = paste0("(1|participant)+(1+", fullfixed, "|model_item)"), main_slopes_correlated = paste0("(1|participant)+(1+", 
            main, "|model_item)"), main_slopes_uncorrelated = independent(c("c2", "c3", "c4", "overall_accuracy_c", 
            "pre1_c", "delta1_c", "pre2_c", "delta2_c")), condition_slopes_only = independent(c("c2", "c3", "c4")), 
            accuracy_slope_only = independent("overall_accuracy_c"), ax_slopes_only = independent(c("pre1_c", "delta1_c", 
                "pre2_c", "delta2_c")), ax1_slopes_only = independent(c("pre1_c", "delta1_c")), ax2_slopes_only = independent(c("pre2_c", 
                "delta2_c")), pre_slopes_only = independent(c("pre1_c", "pre2_c")), change_slopes_only = independent(c("delta1_c", 
                "delta2_c")), pre1_slope_only = independent("pre1_c"), pre2_slope_only = independent("pre2_c"), 
            change1_slope_only = independent("delta1_c"), change2_slope_only = independent("delta2_c"), random_intercepts = independent(character()))
        converged <- function(f) {
            if (!inherits(f, "merMod")) 
                return(FALSE)
            msg <- f@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
            (is.null(f@optinfo$conv$opt) || all(f@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)) && length(msg[!grepl("boundary.*singular", 
                msg)]) == 0
        }
        eligible <- function(f) converged(f) && !isSingular(f) && is.null(attr(getME(f, "X"), "col.dropped"))
        fit_cached <- function(form, dd, key) {
            wf_glmer(form, dd, legacy = file.path(legacy_model_dir, paste0("RQ3_posthoc_", key, ".rds")), optimizer = "nloptwrap")
        }
        all_candidates <- list()
        all_selection <- list()
        all_comparisons <- list()
        for (lang in c("hindi", "korean", "mandarin")) {
            dd <- droplevels(as.data.frame(filter(d, language == lang)))
            dd$response <- dd[[switch(outcome, overall = "correct", Cue1 = "cue1_match", Cue2 = "cue2_match")]]
            for (k in 2:4) dd[[paste0("c", k)]] <- as.numeric(dd$condition == as.character(k))
            fits <- list()
            records <- list()
            for (nm in names(rhs)) {
                wf_note("RQ3", lang, outcome, "candidate", nm)
                f <- fit_cached(as.formula(paste("response~", fullfixed, "+", rhs[[nm]])), dd, paste(lang, outcome, 
                  "candidate", nm, sep = "_"))
                fits[[nm]] <- f
                ok <- inherits(f, "merMod")
                records[[nm]] <- tibble(language = lang, outcome = outcome, candidate = nm, converged = converged(f), 
                  singular = if (ok) 
                    isSingular(f)
                  else NA, eligible = eligible(f), AIC = if (ok) 
                    AIC(f)
                  else NA_real_, BIC = if (ok) 
                    BIC(f)
                  else NA_real_, random_effects = rhs[[nm]], diagnostic = if (ok) 
                    paste(f@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages, collapse = "; ")
                  else conditionMessage(f))
                write_csv(bind_rows(c(all_candidates, records)), paste0("rq3_posthoc_candidates_", outcome, ".csv"))
            }
            tab <- bind_rows(records)
            stopifnot(any(tab$eligible))
            best <- tab %>% filter(eligible) %>% slice_min(AIC, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(candidate)
            tab <- mutate(tab, selected = candidate == best)
            all_candidates[[lang]] <- tab
            current <- fits[[best]]
            active <- interactions
            step <- 0
            comparison_rows <- list()
            repeat {
                step <- step + 1
                trials <- list()
                reduced_fits <- list()
                if (!length(active)) 
                  break
                for (term in active) {
                  wf_note("RQ3", lang, outcome, "interaction step", step, term)
                  reduced_terms <- setdiff(active, term)
                  f <- fit_cached(as.formula(paste("response~", paste(c(main, reduced_terms), collapse = "+"), 
                    "+", rhs[[best]])), dd, paste(lang, outcome, "step", step, gsub(":", "_", term), sep = "_"))
                  reduced_fits[[term]] <- f
                  ok <- eligible(f)
                  lr <- pv <- df <- NA_real_
                  if (inherits(f, "merMod")) {
                    stopifnot(identical(model.response(model.frame(f)), model.response(model.frame(current))), 
                      nobs(f) == nobs(current))
                    cmp <- as.data.frame(anova(f, current, test = "Chisq"))
                    lr <- cmp$Chisq[2]
                    pv <- cmp$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
                    df <- cmp$Df[2]
                    if (as.numeric(logLik(f)) > as.numeric(logLik(current)) + 1e-04) 
                      ok <- FALSE
                  }
                  trials[[term]] <- tibble(language = lang, outcome = outcome, step = step, term = term, reduced_eligible = ok, 
                    LR = lr, df = df, p = pv, AIC_current = AIC(current), AIC_reduced = if (inherits(f, "merMod")) 
                      AIC(f)
                    else NA_real_)
                }
                tests <- bind_rows(trials)
                chosen <- if (nrow(remove)) 
                  remove$term[1]
                else ""
                tests$removed <- tests$term == chosen
                comparison_rows[[as.character(step)]] <- tests
                if (!nzchar(chosen)) 
                  break
                current <- reduced_fits[[chosen]]
                active <- setdiff(active, chosen)
            }
            stopifnot(eligible(current), all(c("condition2", "condition3", "condition4", "overall_accuracy_c", 
                "pre1_c", "delta1_c", "pre2_c", "delta2_c") %in% names(fixef(current))))
            wf_save(current, file.path("models", paste0("RQ3_posthoc_final_", lang, "_", outcome, ".rds")))
            capture.output(summary(current), file = file.path("models", paste0("RQ3_posthoc_final_", lang, "_", 
                outcome, "_summary.txt")))
            all_comparisons[[lang]] <- bind_rows(comparison_rows)
            all_selection[[lang]] <- tibble(language = lang, outcome = outcome, selected_random = best, participants = n_distinct(dd$participant), 
                trials = nobs(current), converged = converged(current), singular = isSingular(current), retained_interactions = if (length(active)) 
                  paste(active, collapse = "; ")
                else "None", AIC = AIC(current), formula = paste(deparse(formula(current)), collapse = " "))
            write_csv(bind_rows(all_candidates), paste0("rq3_posthoc_candidates_", outcome, ".csv"))
            write_csv(bind_rows(all_selection), paste0("rq3_posthoc_selected_", outcome, ".csv"))
            write_csv(bind_rows(all_comparisons), paste0("rq3_posthoc_interaction_tests_", outcome, ".csv"))
            flush.console()
        }
    }
})
```

```{r posthoc-setup}
wf_note("SECTION posthoc-setup")
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
ph_p <- normalizePath(output_dir)
ph_labels <- list(hindi = c(Cue1 = "Aspiration", Cue2 = "Voicing"), korean = c(Cue1 = "Stop (b–bb)", Cue2 = "Coda (n–ng)"), 
    mandarin = c(Cue1 = "Tone (1–3)", Cue2 = "Consonant (zh–j)"))
ph_title <- function(lang, outcome) paste(tools::toTitleCase(lang), if (outcome == "overall") "Whole-word accuracy" else paste(ph_labels[[lang]][[outcome]], 
    "accuracy"), sep = " — ")
ph_selected <- bind_rows(lapply(c("overall", "Cue1", "Cue2"), function(o) read_csv(file.path(ph_p, paste0("rq3_posthoc_selected_", 
    o, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)))
stopifnot(nrow(ph_selected) == 9, all(ph_selected$converged), !any(ph_selected$singular))
ph_selected$model <- mapply(ph_title, ph_selected$language, ph_selected$outcome)
ph_data <- read_csv(file.path(ph_p, "rq3_posthoc_data_overall.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ph_coef <- list()
ph_pred <- list()
for (o in c("overall", "Cue1", "Cue2")) for (lang in c("hindi", "korean", "mandarin")) {
    f <- readRDS(file.path(ph_p, "models", paste0("RQ3_posthoc_final_", lang, "_", o, ".rds")))
    cc <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(f)))
    one <- ph_labels[[lang]][["Cue1"]]
    two <- ph_labels[[lang]][["Cue2"]]
    labels <- c(`(Intercept)` = "Intercept (least dense; mean predictors)", condition2 = paste0(one, " dense (baseline: least dense)"), 
        condition3 = paste0(two, " dense (baseline: least dense)"), condition4 = "Both dense (baseline: least dense)", 
        overall_accuracy_c = "Initial whole-word accuracy", pre1_c = paste(one, "pre-test AX"), delta1_c = paste(one, 
            "AX change"), pre2_c = paste(two, "pre-test AX"), delta2_c = paste(two, "AX change"), `pre1_c:delta1_c` = paste(one, 
            "pre-test AX × AX change"), `pre2_c:delta2_c` = paste(two, "pre-test AX × AX change"), `condition2:overall_accuracy_c` = paste0(one, 
            " dense × initial accuracy\n(baseline: least-dense slope)"), `condition3:overall_accuracy_c` = paste0(two, 
            " dense × initial accuracy\n(baseline: least-dense slope)"), `condition4:overall_accuracy_c` = "Both dense × initial accuracy\n(baseline: least-dense slope)")
    stopifnot(all(rownames(cc) %in% names(labels)))
    ph_coef[[paste(lang, o)]] <- tibble(language = lang, outcome = o, model = ph_title(lang, o), term = rownames(cc), 
        label = unname(labels[rownames(cc)]), estimate = cc$Estimate, SE = cc$`Std. Error`, p = cc$`Pr(>|z|)`, 
        lower = cc$Estimate - 1.96 * cc$`Std. Error`, upper = cc$Estimate + 1.96 * cc$`Std. Error`)
    dd <- filter(ph_data, language == lang)
    for (co in as.character(1:4)) {
        people <- dd %>% filter(as.character(condition) == co) %>% distinct(participant, overall_accuracy_c)
        grid <- data.frame(condition = factor(rep(co, 80), levels = as.character(1:4)), overall_accuracy_c = seq(min(people$overall_accuracy_c), 
            max(people$overall_accuracy_c), length.out = 80), pre1_c = 0, delta1_c = 0, pre2_c = 0, delta2_c = 0)
        xx <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(nobars(formula(f)))), grid)
        eta <- as.vector(xx %*% fixef(f))
        se <- sqrt(rowSums((xx %*% vcov(f)) * xx))
        ph_pred[[paste(lang, o, co)]] <- tibble(language = lang, outcome = o, model = ph_title(lang, o), condition = co, 
            initial_accuracy = grid$overall_accuracy_c + dd$overall_accuracy_center[1], estimate = plogis(eta), 
            lower = plogis(eta - 1.96 * se), upper = plogis(eta + 1.96 * se))
    }
}
ph_coefficients <- bind_rows(ph_coef)
ph_predictions <- bind_rows(ph_pred)
stopifnot(nrow(ph_predictions) == 2880, all(is.finite(ph_predictions$estimate)))
write_csv(ph_coefficients, file.path(ph_p, "rq3_posthoc_coefficients.csv"))
write_csv(ph_predictions, file.path(ph_p, "rq3_posthoc_predictions.csv"))
```
